Road to Valhalla — Mjølner Trail & March

An exceptionally long Viking-themed endurance challenge around Bornholm.

Bornholm, Denmark · 11 November 2027 · 248 km

Organiser information checked 24 November 2026. Dates and rules can change.

Choose your distance

The 2027 programme lists 21.7 km, 35 km, 45 km, 124 km and 248 km options. The longest starts at Nordskovens Camping in Rønne on 11 November.

Historical rules, not yet confirmed for 2027

The 2026 rules required a support car for the first day and set a 60-hour walking or 48-hour running limit. Participants carried navigation and safety kit, with resupply stops and a drop bag available. The 2027 rules need to be checked before planning your attempt.

Plan your adventure

Build experience with consecutive long outings, darkness, exposed coastal terrain and navigation. Arrange the support required by the current rules, and decide in advance how to withdraw safely. Do not add ballast to an already demanding event without checking the rules.

Route and logistics

The historical event page publishes GPX files. Download the current organiser files and inspect them locally using our route viewer. Do not assume a previous route or schedule is unchanged.

Check current dates, entry rules and availability before booking.
